violations.text: The presence of pest is not controlled as evidenced by flying insects (flies). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment has already moved compost buckets from away from doors, establishment is to work with pest control to eliminate the presence of pests. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026
